title: Sunaiva Gate — Agent Rule Enforcement
description: MCP enforcement layer that intercepts AI agent actions and blocks rule violations before execution.

offersHint: MCP enforcement layer that intercepts AI agent actions and blocks rule violations before execution. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.sunaivacore.io · Packages: npm:@sunaiva/gate · Env vars: DISABLE_SUNAIVA_GATE, SUNAIVA_GATE_API_KEY, SUNAIVA_GATE_DRY_RUN

environmentVariables.name: SUNAIVA_GATE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Pro-tier API key for premium rules. Free tier (35 local rules: 27 constitutional + 8 recommended-default) needs no key.

environmentVariables.name: SUNAIVA_GATE_DRY_RUN
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to evaluate without blocking — writes 'would_have_blocked' to audit log.

environmentVariables.name: DISABLE_SUNAIVA_GATE
environmentVariables.description: Emergency kill-switch: set to '1' to allow all actions unconditionally.

toolsPreview.name: validate_action
toolsPreview.description: Check if a proposed action passes all active validation rules. Returns allowed/blocked with rule violations.

toolsPreview.name: log_bypass
toolsPreview.description: Record an intentional rule bypass with justification. Cannot bypass constitutional rules.

toolsPreview.name: get_rules
toolsPreview.description: List active validation rules — the customer's TRUE enforced set (constitutional + recommended-default metadata on dev tier, all 69 premium rules on pro+). `category`/`preset` filter args are accepted but not applied server-side.

toolsPreview.name: update_rules
toolsPreview.description: [Planned — not yet implemented on the remote endpoint, returns NOT_IMPLEMENTED] Enable/disable is not backed by any route in this API; use set_rule_mode (shadow/advisory/enforce) instead, or the local `npx @sunaiva/gate` package.

toolsPreview.name: get_audit_log
toolsPreview.description: View recent gate decisions — blocks, warnings, passes, and bypasses.

toolsPreview.name: ship_confidence_check
toolsPreview.description: [Planned — not yet implemented on the remote endpoint, returns NOT_IMPLEMENTED] Ship Confidence Gate (Rule 42) dual-tier authorization is not yet built in this backend.

toolsPreview.name: audit_verify
toolsPreview.description: [Planned — not yet implemented on the remote endpoint, returns NOT_IMPLEMENTED] Forward-linked hash-chain / ed25519 audit-log verification is not yet built in this backend.

toolsPreview.name: set_rule_mode
toolsPreview.description: Set enforcement mode (shadow/advisory/enforce) for a specific rule. Requires API key (Pro+).

toolsPreview.name: get_rule_modes
toolsPreview.description: List all enforcement-mode overrides configured for the authenticated customer. Requires an account (Dev+).

toolsPreview.name: reset_rule_mode
toolsPreview.description: Remove a mode override for a rule, reverting it to its default enforcement mode. Requires API key (Pro+).

toolsPreview.name: add_custom_rule
toolsPreview.description: Create a custom detection rule in the backend. Requires API key (Pro+).

toolsPreview.name: update_custom_rule
toolsPreview.description: Update an existing custom rule. Requires API key (Pro+).

toolsPreview.name: delete_custom_rule
toolsPreview.description: Delete a custom rule. Requires API key (Pro+).

toolsPreview.name: list_custom_rules
toolsPreview.description: List all custom rules for the authenticated customer. Requires API key (Pro+).

toolsPreview.name: list_presets
toolsPreview.description: List available rule preset bundles. Requires API key (Dev+).

toolsPreview.name: apply_preset
toolsPreview.description: Apply a preset bundle, activating all its included rules. Requires API key (Pro+).
